title: Living arrangements and his children
summary: He was never staying at home during the 30s and 40s, sent money home, volunteered for the army, and lists his children.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: I might find some of it. That's about all the things. You know all these years when you were playing in the 30s and the 40s, where were you living
during this time? Anywhere and everywhere. It wasn't no particular place. Like you see I never was staying at home.

I always make money and send it home you know. That's how I stayed away from my wife so long that I felt like why should I be there in her way? And they're not eating and sleeping correctly if I wasn't there maybe some guy would pass along you know.
Well that's sometimes a good way to be.
That's why I volunteered to go in the army. If I couldn't afford them I mean I didn't need them you know.
It's a good way to be sometimes.

I got hurt in a few spots in it but I don't regret it. I'm proud of it right on. I got some extra children when I came back. Well you had only two when you left and you had four when you came back? Yeah let me say two, four.

I had six when I came back. Oh my gosh. You still have six today? No I got seven. You got seven? But some of them are older now. You got to know you've got some older daughters. Yeah. Daughters are older and you got a son that's older.

Yeah and I got a baby daughter. The baby girl she's going into 18 this year. And my oldest son would be around 34 or 35. I think my number two son ought to be around 34 or 33. One was born in 42 and the other was born in 43 so.

So now I got a number one daughter and I got a number two daughter and a baby daughter. And I got a number one son, a number two son, I got a number three son, and a number four son, which he's studying to be a disc jockey at the time now.

He's learning talents but in a different mood. He wants to be a disc jockey. He's been into every little thing that he can get into and I don't block him, it's just a pleasure that maybe someday they'll find their place and it's good to know a little of everything if you can anyway. That's a good thing. So now the baby wants to go to college and by all means I want to see if he can get to there.
